reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Local Redirect Policy, when enabled with socket-based load-balancing, redirects traffic from policy-selected node-local backends destined to the policy's…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Local Redirect Policies without an explicit skipRedirectFromBackend setting will now redirect traffic from node-local backends back to themselves when using socket-based load-balancing, changing the traffic forwarding behavior.

proposed.statement: Local Redirect Policy with socket-based load-balancing now redirects traffic from node-local backends destined to the policy's frontend back to the node-local backends by default; set skipRedirectFromBackend to true to override this.
